AVIATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aircraft Basic Maintenance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.

   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
